table.deleteBulkConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {count} workflow(s)? This action cannot be undone.

bulk.hint: Choose an action to apply to the selected workflows.

builder.inspectorHint: Configure the workflow and the selected step.
builder.workflowDetailsHint: Name, type, and description for this automation.
builder.stepDetailsHint: Configure the selected trigger, action, or condition.
builder.selectNodeHint: Select a node on the canvas to configure it. Drag from a node handle to connect or add a step. Click a line to disconnect it. Press Delete to remove.

triggerHints.stock_below: Fires when a selected product variant hits its low-stock threshold
triggerHints.new_buyer: Fires when a new buyer is created, which happens on their first order
triggerHints.buyer_questions: Fires when a buyer asks about business, products, or operations on WhatsApp
triggerHints.order_paid: Fires on payment. Choose whether that means the status becomes Paid or the buyer submits proof
triggerHints.return_accepted: Fires when a return is received and stock can be restored
triggerHints.cart_idle: Fires when a marketplace cart stays idle for X hours
triggerHints.campaign_schedule: Send a chosen campaign at a set date and time

actionHints.replenish_stock: Write replenish quantity into stock when the workflow is active
actionHints.whatsapp_buyer: Message a selected buyer about low stock via WhatsApp
actionHints.draft_activate_offer: Draft or activate a clearance offer for a set window
actionHints.assign_agent_whatsapp: Assign a sales agent and send a welcome WhatsApp
actionHints.buyer_question_reply: Reply with pre-authored messages; escalate out-of-scope to an agent
actionHints.assign_fleet: Match fleet by capacity, area, or load and push the driver
actionHints.return_confirm_whatsapp: Confirm stock restore and notify the buyer on WhatsApp
actionHints.cart_winback: WhatsApp / push win-back with cart summary and optional offer
actionHints.send_campaign: Send an existing campaign through WhatsApp or Email
actionHints.notify_dashboard: Show a notification on the distributor dashboard

builder.conditionExpressionPlaceholder: e.g. stock < threshold, CTA = Buy now
builder.conditionHint: Connect from any side. Drag out Yes and No branches from this IF step.
builder.appWebhookHint: Connect your WhatsApp Business account for messaging and product offer promotions
builder.appEmailHint: Connect your Gmail account for messaging and product offer promotions
builder.appConnected: Business account linked to this workflow
builder.appWhatsAppConnectHint: This connects your business WhatsApp line. Buyer phone and message template stay on WhatsApp actions such as WhatsApp buyer.
builder.appGmailConnectHint: This connects your business Gmail. Recipient and message content stay on email actions.
builder.buyerPickerHint: Pick an existing buyer. Their phone number is used for WhatsApp delivery.
builder.buyerPickerHintMulti: Select one or more buyers. Use Update status in bulk if needed, then confirm with Use selected.
